calls.title: Jonathan Trengrove and James Shannon
calls.summary: The meeting focused on the adoption of an experimentation platform, specifically GrowthBook, as a strategic tool to foster better decision-making and reduce reliance on opinions. Jonathan highlighted strong internal support from both the backend data and frontend engineering teams, indicating a willingness to trial GrowthBook. The discussion emphasized a code-first implementation preference to align with internal engineering capabilities and the integration of GrowthBook with existing AI and data systems. Participants acknowledged the need for a cultural shift towards data-driven decisions, requiring cross-team collaboration to enhance buy-in and address compliance measures. Moving forward, a 30–45 day trial plan was proposed, alongside next steps for engagement and pricing discussions.
calls.keywords: Feature Flags, Code-based Experimentation, Databricks Integration, Compliance Workflow, AI Assistant Claude, Trial Implementation
